question: dame los diez países de comercio con más volumen liquidado, con el volumen en euros
sql: SELECT d.country_code, SUM(f.gross_eur_minor) AS volume_eur FROM fact_settlement_batch f JOIN dim_merchant m ON f.merchant_id = m.merchant_id JOIN dim_country c ON m.country_code = c.country_code WHERE m.is_active = true GROUP BY d.country_code ORDER BY volume_eur DESC LIMIT 10
